data.issue: The payroll total is wrong: the six payments sum to 10020.51, not 9020.51, so the KV total, report total, and the email body are all incorrect. Step s10 also adds an unrequested payment of 1957.62 to ACCT-FAB-5259 with memo 'additional order', which is not in the task and whose instruction contradicts its target account (it says ACCT-MCX-2291).
